title: SiteStateBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Batch of state snapshots (int:SiteState) for multiple Sites, all belonging to the same Community, mirroring the SiteMeasurement schema's hierarchy.

communityId.description: FK to the Community that all Sites in this batch belong to.

items.description: State snapshots for one Site within the batch.

siteId.description: FK to the Site these state snapshots belong to.

items.description: A single state snapshot for a Site (int:SiteState).

timestamp.description: Timestamp of this site state snapshot. ISO 8601 with timezone.

occupancy.description: Number of occupants at the site.
